payload.artist_html: J. Jiang, L.-P. Dong, X. Xu, A. Bi, & S. Evans
payload.credit_html: "A new polyglyphanodontian lizard from the Upper Cretaceous of southern China implies a complex evolutionary history of the clade"
payload.description_html: The skull of Xenodontolacerta fangi (holotype CVEB20180206) in lateral (a,c) and ventral (b,d) views. (a,b) Digital images; (c,d) line drawings of (a,b), respectively. an, angular; ar, articular; c, coronoid; d, dentary; ju, jugal; mx, maxilla; na, nasal; o, orbit; par, parietal; pmx, premaxilla; pob, postorbital; pof, postfrontal; qu, quadrate; sa, surangular; spl, splenial; sq, squamosal.
